request: Add chamfer to main/biggest cylindrical section of Heatbreak body/component. The chamfer should be same size as present on top of the part, but should be added to the lower edge of the cylinder. This should allow easier insertion of the part during assembly.

parameters.chamfer_size: Same size as the existing chamfer present on the top of the part.

actions.target: The lower edge of the main/biggest cylindrical section of the Heatbreak body/component.
actions.relational_constraint: Apply the chamfer to the lower edge of the same cylinder and match its size to the chamfer already present on the top of the part.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the Heatbreak body/component, its main or largest cylindrical section, the lower edge of that cylinder, and the existing top chamfer whose size must be matched.

intention: Allow easier insertion of the part during assembly.
